definition: BentoML packages ML models into production API services with batching, containerisation and GPU support.
details: Created by Chaoyu Yang in 2019; developed by BentoML, Inc.

explainer.lead: How to install BentoML, a first working example, and where it fits in an AI project.
explainer.inAi: Turn a notebook model into a scalable service with adaptive batching, then build a Docker image with one command.
explainer.jsNote: BentoML is a Python library with no official JavaScript or TypeScript package; call it from a Python service if your app is written in JavaScript.

tiers.eli5: It puts your trained model in a ready-to-serve box so other programs can request predictions from it.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers wrap a model in a BentoML service to get batching and containerised deployment. A pitfall is that service configuration such as batching and GPU settings must match the real traffic and hardware, or latency suffers.
tiers.paperLevel: A framework created in 2019 by Chaoyu Yang and developed by BentoML, Inc., that turns models into API services with batching, containerisation and GPU support. Its scope is serving, not training.

explainer.example: A trained classifier is packaged as a BentoML service and deployed as a container that batches incoming prediction requests.
